# Muhammad Usama (UsamaOps) — DevOps, SRE & AI Integration

> Muhammad Usama, trading as UsamaOps (usamaops.com), is a freelance Senior DevOps and Site Reliability Engineer based in Lahore, Pakistan (UTC+5), working remotely with startups, SaaS companies and established businesses worldwide. Works across AWS, Google Cloud (GCP), Oracle Cloud (OCI), Huawei Cloud and multi-cloud setups, and runs PCI DSS-scoped payment infrastructure in production with Kubernetes and Terraform. Sells fixed-price packages for cloud cost reduction, CI/CD and infrastructure as code, TLS certificate automation, SOC 2 / PCI DSS infrastructure readiness, and low-cost AI integration.

Contact: hello@usamaops.com or WhatsApp +92 313 4236974 (https://wa.me/923134236974). All prices are in USD. Available for fixed-price projects or as a remote, fractional DevOps/SRE engineer on a monthly retainer.

## DevOps & SRE packages

- Infrastructure Health Check: 5 business days, read-only review of cloud, CI/CD, security, monitoring and certificates with a risk-scored 30/60/90-day plan. $750 for the first 3 clients, then $1,500.
- Cloud Cost Teardown (AWS, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud, Huawei Cloud, multi-cloud): 1–2 weeks, $1,200–2,000. Guarantees at least 2x the fee in annualised savings for teams spending $3,000+ a month on cloud, or no charge.
- Cert & Secrets Automation: 1–2 weeks, $2,000–4,000. Certificate inventory, ACME/cert-manager renewal, expiry alerts, rotation runbook; ready for 100-day TLS certificates (from March 15, 2027).
- CI/CD + IaC Foundation: 2–4 weeks, $3,000–6,000. Terraform, GitHub Actions, environments, secrets and rollback.
- Compliance Infra Readiness (SOC 2 / PCI DSS): 2–4 weeks, $3,000–8,000. Fixes the infrastructure controls auditors check; does not issue audit reports.
- Fractional DevOps/SRE: $1,500–3,000 a month, 3-month minimum.

## AI integration packages

- AI Opportunity & Cost Review: 3–5 days, $750. Finds the tasks where AI saves real hours, with model cost estimates and a build plan.
- AI Workflow Automation: 1–3 weeks, $1,500–4,000. One business process automated end to end with human review, logging and spend caps.
- Production AI Integration: 2–4 weeks, $3,000–8,000. LLM features in production with secrets management, rate limits, per-customer spend caps, PII redaction, provider fallbacks, evaluations and cost dashboards.
